title: Goku's Five Strongest Dragon Ball Forms, Ranked
summary:
Dragon Ball is one of the most famous anime franchises in the world. Created by Akira Toriyama more than 40 years ago, it shaped countless shows that came after it. Its hero, Goku, is hungry, hardworking and always getting stronger. A writer for the website /Film has ranked Goku's five strongest forms.

Number five is Super Saiyan God, first seen in the movie Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods. Goku cannot reach it alone. Five Saiyans must share their energy, called ki, with him in a special ritual. His hair and eyes turn red, and he can predict his opponent's moves. But at first he could only keep the form for a short time.

Next comes Super Saiyan Blue Kaio-ken. Kaio-ken is an old technique that boosts Goku's speed and power. Combining it with Super Saiyan Blue makes him even stronger, but it was so hard to control that it left him weak and tired for days. Because of that downside, the writer ranks it lower.

Third is Super Saiyan Blue. Goku's hair and eyes turn bright blue, and he gains a crackling electric glow. It became his main power-up throughout Dragon Ball Super.

Second is Ultra Instinct Sign, which Goku unlocked during the Tournament of Power. His hair gets silver highlights, and his eyes turn silver. Instead of a new supernatural look, this form relies on martial arts skill. Goku reacts instantly to attacks and can dodge without much thought.

At the top is Perfected Ultra Instinct. It let Goku defeat the powerful fighter Jiren. It needs a perfectly calm mind and uses lots of energy. But the writer says Goku can keep training it, so its power may have no limit.
why_it_matters: Dragon Ball's ideas about training, focus and growth have shaped anime around the world, and ranking the forms shows how the story rewards hard work and a calm mind.

background_read: Dragon Ball began as a Japanese comic, called manga, before becoming animated TV series, movies and games watched around the world.
In the story, Goku is a Saiyan, a powerful warrior race whose members can transform into stronger forms.
Each new transformation usually appears when Goku faces a tougher opponent, which keeps the story building toward bigger battles.
Fans often debate which form is strongest because each one has different strengths and drawbacks, such as how much energy it uses.

perspectives.description: Ranks Perfected Ultra Instinct first because Goku can keep training it, and places Super Saiyan Blue Kaio-ken lower because of its downsides.
